```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(glmmTMB)
library(ggformula)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE,
                      # change to true to cache results
                      cache = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# rows in sim dataset
n <- 500
# size of RE groups
n_re <- 2
# x1 slope
b1 <- 1.5
# x2 slope
b2 <- -0.5
# random intercept standard deviation
group_sd <- 0.5
# residual standard deviation
resid_sd <- 1
```


```{r}
acf_values = data.frame(acfs = rep.int(NA, 1000)) # premade data frame of proper current length

for (i in 1:1000) {
  sim_data <- data.frame(
    # values of predictor #1
    x1 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    # values of predictor #2
    x2 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    # third candidate predictor that is NOT assoc w/respone
    x3 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    # random effect group assignment
    re_group = gl(n = floor(n/2),
                  k = n_re,
                  length = n),
    # residuals
    resid = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = resid_sd)) |>
    # random intercepts
    group_by(re_group) |>
    mutate(alpha = rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = group_sd)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(response = 0 + alpha + b1 * x1 + b2 * x2 + resid) # note: response value does not include x3
  
    model <- glmmTMB(response ~ x1 + x2 + (1 | re_group), data = sim_data)
    summary(model)
    acf_out <- acf(resid(model), plot = FALSE)
    acf_values$acfs[i] = acf_out$acf[acf_out$lag == 1] # send values at lag 1 to the premade data frame
}
```


```{r}
acf_logicals = data.frame(acfs = rep.int(NA, 1000)) # create a data frame for logicals of greater than 0 or not

for (i in 1:1000) {
  acf_logicals$acfs[i] <- acf_values$acfs[i] < 0
  if(acf_values$acfs[i] >= 0) {
    print(i)
    print(acf_values$acfs[i]) 
    # print the values greater than 0 and where they occur (for my own ability to judge if it seems skewed)
    # (this is not actually important)
    }
}
```

```{r}
acf_greater = list() # test list for being beyond the bound
counter = 1
for (i in 1:1000) {
  if(acf_values$acfs[i] <= -.1) { # the bound is currently set at -.1 based on my eyeballing it
                                  # this will need to change as its actually based on sample size
   acf_greater[counter] <- acf_values$acfs[i]
   counter = counter + 1 # used because if you use i, it creates a lot of empty rows (I know this is kind of a janky setup)
  }
}
```
